comparison.objective: Screen media from washers vs remove capped Luer-lock needles and discard them safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual screen motion governing granular flow vs stabilize syringes while twisting and extracting millimetre-scale threaded needles without uncapping.
comparison.success_condition: Recovery fraction, retained washers, no spill/damage, released screen dwell vs each needle unscrewed and released inside sharps container, with any bare needle causing zero.
comparison.reason: Both involve containment, but the tested contact mechanics—sifting versus threaded disassembly—are unrelated.
